Ms. Anu Mehta is a Human Resources professional with over 30 years of experience in strategic human resource management, organizational development, talent management, employee engagement and change management. She has been associated with Honda Cars India Limited and Honda Motor India since 2004 and has held various senior management positions during her tenure. Her professional experience spans across Corporate HR, Sales HR, Factory HR, R & D HR, Industrial Relations, Administration, Safety, Security, Legal, Corporate Affairs and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). She has expertise in conceptualization and implementation of processes related to HR strategy, manpower planning, performance management, leadership development, succession planning, compensation management and organizational restructuring. She has also led various CSR initiatives in the areas of education, healthcare, road safety and environmental sustainability. Ms. Anu Mehta holds an MBA in Finance/Human Resources from Spicer Memorial College, Pune, and a B.Sc. (Honours) degree from the University of Delhi.
